name: WeekWeave
title: Calendar Feed Integration & Conflict Review
problem: Separate calendars obscure duplicate events, timezone differences and overlapping busy periods.
solution: A working ICS file/feed integrator that normalizes times, merges exact duplicates, finds overlaps and exports a consolidated calendar.
features: ICS upload, paste or real HTTP feed import
IANA timezone normalization and DST validation
Exact duplicate merging and busy-event overlap review
Consolidated ICS and spreadsheet-safe conflict CSV export
verification: 13 automated tests passed. Actual HTTP verification feeds yield 9 merged events from 10 source events, with 1 duplicate and 2 overlapping pairs.
limitations: New independent project with fictional verification calendars. Documented RFC 5545 subset: recurrence and embedded VTIMEZONE/VALARM rejected. Local single-user service; no OAuth, source writeback, automatic refresh or public deployment.
flow: ICS files / HTTP feeds → Validate whole source → Normalize & persist → Merge exact matches → Review overlaps → ICS / CSV export
captions: Separate HTTP verification feeds become one timezone-aligned calendar with source labels.
Actual merged calendar events and two computed overlap intervals, with source labels and import controls.
